mapper.sql: s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.credit AS credit, s.teacher_id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, s.classroom_id AS classroomId, cr.classroom_name AS classroomName, cr.classroom_code AS classroomCode, cr.classroom_type AS classroomType, cr.capacity AS capacity, s.time_slot_id AS timeSlotId, ts.slot_name AS slotName, ts.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, ts.start_period AS startPeriod, ts.end_period AS endPeriod, s.clazz_id AS clazzId, cl.class_name AS className, s.semester AS semester, s.week_start AS weekStart, s.week_end AS weekEnd, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, s.gmt_create AS gmtCreate

edu_schedule s LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN edu_classroom cr ON s.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id LEFT JOIN edu_time_slot ts ON s.time_slot_id = ts.slot_id LEFT JOIN edu_class cl ON s.clazz_id = cl.class_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM
ORDER BY s.semester, ts.day_of_week, ts.start_period LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT schedule_id AS id, course_id AS courseId, teacher_id AS teacherId, classroom_id AS classroomId, time_slot_id AS timeSlotId, clazz_id AS clazzId, semester AS semester, week_start AS weekStart, week_end AS weekEnd, schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, schedule_deleted AS scheduleDeleted, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM edu_schedule WHERE semester = #{semester} AND schedule_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE edu_schedule SET schedule_deleted = 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE semester = #{semester}
